hero.title: Routes that fit your distance and the streets you like.
hero.lead: Set a start, a finish and how far you want to go. Say what matters to you, like parks or quiet streets, and choose from routes that fit.

illustration.label: Example map. Route A, drawn in yellow, runs from a start triangle through waypoints 1 and 2 to a finish circle. Route B is drawn in grey.
illustration.caption: Example: two routes for a 10 km run. Route A is selected.
illustration.scaleLabel: Scale: this bar is 1 km on the map.

start.title: Place your points
start.body: Put a start and a finish on the map. Add waypoints if there is somewhere you want to pass.

distance.title: Target distance
distance.body: Say how far you want to go.

preferences.title: What matters
preferences.body: Weigh green space, quiet streets and places worth passing.

pick.title: Pick a route
pick.body: Compare the routes that fit, adjust the one you like, and save it for later.

errors.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name{'@'}example.com.
errors.passwordTooShort: Use at least {min} characters for your password.
errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match. Check them and try again.
errors.emailTaken: There is already an account with this email. Sign in instead.
errors.invalidInput: Check your details and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

createAccount.title: Create account
createAccount.lead: Save your routes and come back to them later.
